title: Change fragment
description: The YAML front matter of a change fragment (changes/fragments/<id>.md). The Markdown after the front matter is the change's details. This file is the one source of the lists of types and scopes: scripts/release.py and autoapply.release read them from here. See docs/release-workflow.md.

id.description: The file name without .md: the date the fragment was written, a slug of 1-5 words, 4 random hex digits. Made by `python scripts/release.py change`.

type.description: What kind of change it is. The release notes have one section per type, in this order.

scope.description: Which part of the product it is about. Independent of the type.

summary.description: One line saying what a user notices. English is required; Simplified Chinese (zh) and French (fr) are optional and fall back to English.

highlight.description: One of the release's main changes: shown first when the release is opened (at most 6 per release).

bump.description: The version impact when it is more than the default patch. Independent of the type.

pr.description: The pull request(s) of the change.
